# Subway Seat for micro

Copy the `.micro` files to `~/.config/micro/colorschemes/`, or run `set colorscheme subway-seat` from micro's command bar. True-colour hex; micro maps it to 256 colours when the terminal can't show it.

[micro](https://micro-editor.github.io) · [All ports and previews](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/micro/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`colorschemes/subway-seat.micro`](colorschemes/subway-seat.micro) | ~/.config/micro/colorschemes/subway-seat.micro |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`colorschemes/subway-seat-tunnel.micro`](colorschemes/subway-seat-tunnel.micro) | ~/.config/micro/colorschemes/subway-seat-tunnel.micro |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`colorschemes/subway-seat-enamel.micro`](colorschemes/subway-seat-enamel.micro) | ~/.config/micro/colorschemes/subway-seat-enamel.micro |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in ~/.config/micro/settings.json:

```json
"colorscheme": "subway-seat"
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in ~/.config/micro/settings.json:

```json
"colorscheme": "subway-seat-tunnel"
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in ~/.config/micro/settings.json:

```json
"colorscheme": "subway-seat-enamel"
```


Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py`. Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
